original_test_intent: Verify every expected physical network port on each adapter is connected to the approved peer and reports correct identity, media, speed, state and health.
original_method: Pin NVSM build; preserve diagnostics; approve loop-safe cable/peer/VLAN topology; load adapter/port/MAC/connector/media/supported-and-expected-speed/peer manifest; run exact `nvsm show networkports` read-only; retain raw link/status/health properties; compare completeness and connection state without changing links.
manual_activity: Network owner approves physical cabling/peers and expected port manifest and dispositions every missing, down, mismatched or non-OK port.
required_inputs: Expected peer, link state, speed/width and health
safety_requirements: Do not connect all ports without loop/peer review
Never clear logs or change link/VLAN/speed settings

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The query is applicable but lacks safe cable topology, expected peers and per-port properties.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the literal command after approved cabling and map every port to its physical adapter/connector and peer.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Connect-all-ports precondition and all port health/information remain in scope.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a physical-port table with adapter, connector, peer, media, expected/observed speed/state and health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes correctness and safe connectivity objective.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Adapter presence or logical interface state cannot prove each physical port.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Connecting ports can create L2 loops or alter production routing; link negotiation depends on peer/media.

project_override_considerations: Network design owns peer mapping, intended unused ports, supported speeds and safe loop isolation.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently target physical port information and health; missing manifest/cabling are project inputs and log clearing is rejected for safety.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Package, port manifest and safe cabling can be supplied; query is read-only.

review_improvement: Binds each reported port to a physical connector and approved peer while preventing unsafe all-port cabling.
independent_technical_reasoning: A port can be Healthy while connected to the wrong peer or negotiating below the intended speed. Physical connector-to-peer identity and link properties must be evaluated together, and connecting all ports needs explicit loop prevention.
